header.title: How to Use a Larger Gas Tank with an Outdoor Grill
header.description: This guide explains how to safely connect and use a larger gas tank with your existing outdoor grill. Follow these simple steps to enjoy extended grilling time without frequent tank refills.

steps.description: Locate a converter hose that is compatible with your grill, either from the manufacturer or a generic option.
actions: Determine the appropriate size of converter hose for your grill.
Check the grill manufacturer's offerings for a converter hose.
Search for a generic converter hose that works with your gas grill.
Visit a home repair store to find a converter hose.

steps.description: Disconnect the old gas tank, and connect the converter hose to both the grill and the new gas tank.
actions: Disconnect the old gas tank using pliers.
Put the old gas tank aside, preventing gas spillage.
Attach the converter hose to the grill where the old gas tank was.
Attach the other end of the hose to the larger gas tank.

steps.description: Connect the gas tank and converter hose to the grill and then turn on the grill.
actions: Connect gas tank to converter hose
